text: Created troubleshooting agent skill at .claude/skills/troubleshooting.md — covers 3-service Railway architecture, OTLP→New Relic observability pipeline, 12 common failure modes with diagnostic paths and runbook cross-references, Railway-specific diagnostics, env var verification, and integration with the existing BUG-FIX-PROTOCOL. Registered as an invocable skill.

Switched OTLP telemetry destination from New Relic to Honeycomb. Changed header format from `Authorization=Basic {key}` to `x-honeycomb-team={key}` in both apps/api and apps/worker TelemetryBootstrapExtensions.cs. Railway env vars still use Telemetry__Otlp__Endpoint and Telemetry__Otlp__ApiKey — just values change to Honeycomb's endpoint (https://api.honeycomb.io) and Ingest API key.

Fixed perpetual WebSocket reconnect cycle: PushAlertProvider.tsx and UserLayout.tsx both called getLiveAlerts().start() on the singleton, causing the second start()'s closeWs() to kill the first connection. The killed connection's onclose fired scheduleReconnect(10s), which killed the real connection 10s later, creating an infinite ~10.8s cycle. Confirmed via HAR (2 entries 11.3s apart, both 101) and Honeycomb (116 connections/2h, P50=10,861ms, all status 101). Fix: removed redundant client.start() from UserLayout.tsx line 57.

Updated all documentation files to replace New Relic references with Honeycomb after the observability vendor migration. Changed files: .claude/skills/troubleshooting.md (full rewrite of observability sections), docs/deployment-phase1-zero-cost.md (entire Step 3, env vars, cost table, diagram), docs/adr/0002-observability-and-configuration.md (historical note), infra/README.md (example URLs), docs/deployment_plan.md (example endpoint), docs/rough_notes.txt (deprecated NR entries). Source code was already using Honeycomb headers (x-honeycomb-team) — only docs needed updating. Created FACT.md with observability setup reference.
